policy: Each entry is a temporary file-level exception to the 90% lines/functions and 85% branches gate. Global coverage remains enforced by Vitest. Exceptions are evidence of an explicit gap, not an exclusion from product coverage.

Account failure and reconciliation branches require browser fault injection.
Administrative session and dead-letter recovery branches require authenticated browser actions and explicit confirmation flows.
Dashboard degraded and realtime branches require browser/runtime failure scenarios.
Indicator fallback branches are validated by the responsive browser lane, not isolated component fixtures.

Patient workspace degraded branches require browser fault injection and scoped runtime fixtures.
Request-detail failure branches are coupled to route navigation and server responses.
